item.tib: gsang gcod nying lag gsum pa ris drug gcod kyi lag len thar ba'i skas lam
item.coloph: de ltar gsang gcod nying lag go/ rigs drug gcod kyi go rim 'di/ rkyang (skyang) sprul nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis/ skal ldan bsam pa 'grub phyir bsdebs/ 'on kyang shes rig mig zhan pas/ ma rtog (rtogs) log pa'i rgyu gyur na/ mkhyen ldan rnams la bzod pa gsol/ ma bden mi 'chab mthol lo bshags/ gzhan yang gdams pa 'di nyid kyis (kyi/)yan lag nying lag grangs mang ste/ so sor rang rang gzhung rnams dang*/ zur gyi zhal shes sogs la ltos//
